test_title: PYST 7: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - Reasoning (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: Introducing a woman, Vivek said, "She is the daughter of my father's only son's wife." How is the woman related to Vivek?
solution:
“She is the daughter of my father’s only son’s wife.”

 
• My father’s only son
 
 
• That is Vivek himself (assuming Vivek is male).
 
 
 
• My father’s only son’s wife
 
 
• That is Vivek’s wife.
 
 
 
• Daughter of my father’s only son’s wife
 
 
• That is Vivek’s daughter.
 
 

 The woman is Vivek’s daughter.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3"**
